connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source:
A connection to the Microsoft OneDrive REST API via Microsoft Graph for cloud file storage and management.

Requires OAuth2 credentials (`oauth2_client_id` and `oauth2_client_secret`) from your [Azure app registration](https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps). The connection uses the `onedrive://` URL scheme
connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message:
Pripojenie k REST API Microsoft OneDrive prostredníctvom Microsoft Graph pre cloudové správu súborov a úložiska.

Vyžaduje OAuth2 povolenia (`oauth2_client_id` a `oauth2_client_secret`) z vášho [Azure aplikácie](https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps). Pripojenie používa `onedrive://` schému URL

connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source: Azure AD tenant ID for authentication; use `common` for multi-tenant apps, `organizations` for work/school accounts only, `consumers` for personal accounts only, or provide a specific tenant ID or domain name
connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message: ID Azure AD tenanta pre overenie; použite `common` pre viacnásobné tenanty, `organizations` pre pracovné/školské účty, `consumers` pre osobné účty, alebo zadajte konkrétny ID tenanta alebo doménu

connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source: A connection to the Microsoft OneDrive REST API via Microsoft Graph
connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message: Pripojenie k rozhraniu OneDrive REST cez Microsoft Graph

connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source:
A connection to Microsoft SharePoint via the Microsoft Graph API, for document libraries and lists.

Requires OAuth2 credentials (`oauth2_client_id` and `oauth2_client_secret`) from your [Azure app registration](https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps). The connection uses the `sharepoint://` URL scheme
connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message:
Spojenie s Microsoft SharePoint prostredníctvom rozhrania API Microsoft Graph pre knižnice dokumentov a zoznamy.

Vyžaduje povolenia OAuth2 (`oauth2_client_id` a `oauth2_client_secret`) z vašej [registrácie aplikácie v Azure](https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps). Spojenie používa schému URL `sharepoint://`

connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.source: A connection to Microsoft SharePoint via the Microsoft Graph API
connection.T25lRHJpdmVSZXN0Q2xpZW50.sche.message: Spojenie s Microsoft SharePoint prostredníctvom rozhrania API Microsoft Graph
